source.note: AC wrong (definition misconceived), per operator direction 2026-10-15: the story asked the binary to know specific cloud providers. As shipped in 0.0.672, internal/cloudid/azure.go hard-codes az login --service-principal and AZURE_CONFIG_DIR, aws.go hard-codes credential_process and STS, and the provider list is closed. That hardcodes user configuration into satelle, the line satelle must never cross (satelle-mechanism-vs-substrate). Superseded by a provider-neutral story that makes the launcher's identity step generic configuration and removes internal/cloudid. Review hardening is filed as sty_476e9bf3.
